RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

The panel’s gender composition alone is not evidence of discrimination; it routinely reflects organizational roles and availability. For a laboratory director position, formal management training and broad administrative leadership often outweigh purely academic credentials like a PhD. The successful candidate possesses credible leadership and management qualifications that justify the appointment.

Raising the panel's gender without concrete evidence of irregular interview procedures or overt bias will appear unfounded and could significantly damage your professional reputation and relationships within the hospital. Instead, send a polite follow-up on your request for written feedback, framing it positively around your professional development and identifying areas to strengthen your candidacy for future leadership roles.
